description: Fork of exp192. Same V2D + per-head Q/K/V + SDPA attention block, but out_proj is a standard 2-layer MLP: Linear(E, 4E, bias=False) -> GELU -> Linear(4E, E, bias=False). fc1 std=0.02; fc2 zero-init so each block starts as identity residual. V2D linear_mode=True. qkv_init_std=0.005. Standard 2-group AdamW (decay/nodecay). Goal: validate the V2D+SDPA half of the architecture; if it works, iterate the LUT out_proj separately.
